So 2.5 rounds to 2, 3.5 rounds to 4 and -2.5 rounds to -2. Anything that is not exactly a half rounds to the nearest whole number.  This is the mode used for tax, discounts, proration and currency translation. Finance asked for it in version 0.4.0.  ## Other modes  Callers can pass a mode explicitly:  | Mode | 2.5 | 3.5 | 2.4 | -2.5 | |---|---|---|---|---| | `half-even` (default) | 2 | 4 | 2 | -2 | | `half-up` | 3 | 4 | 2 | -3 | | `down` | 2 | 3 | 2 | -2 |  `half-up` always rounds an exact half away from zero. `down` drops the fraction, towards zero.  ## Sign  Rounding is symmetric. The result for a negative value is always the negative of the result for the same positive value, so a credit rounds the same way as the charge it reverses.  ## Splitting an amount  Splits (`allocate`) do not round each part on its own. Every part gets the whole units of its exact share, and the units left over go to the parts with the largest fractions, earlier lines first on a tie. The parts add up to the amount exactly.
